/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import json,os,urllib.request,collections,re
p=json.load(open('sample-out.json'))
r=urllib.request.Request('https://api.assemblyai.com/v2/transcript/'+p['transcript_id'],headers={'authorization':os.environ['ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY']})
with urllib.request.urlopen(r) as response: remote=json.load(response)
print('Output keys:', sorted(p))
print('Speakers:', sorted({u['speaker'] for u in p['utterances']}))
print('Utterances:',len(p['utterances']))
print('Redaction markers:',dict(collections.Counter(re.findall(r'\\[[A-Z_]+\\]',p['text']))))
print('Stored text matches output:',p['text']==remote['text'])
print('Stored utterances match:',p['utterances']==[{'speaker':u['speaker'],'text':u['text']} for u in remote['utterances']])
print('Unredacted fields populated:',any(remote.get(k) for k in ['unredacted_text','unredacted_words','unredacted_utterances']))
print('Privacy flags:',{k:remote.get(k) for k in ['redact_pii','redact_pii_policies','redact_pii_return_unredacted']})
print('Unexpected digit sequences:',bool(re.search(r'\\d{3}',p['text'])))
PY"
